name: MMRC
title: mMRC (Modified Medical Research Council) Dyspnea Scale
description: Stratifies severity of dyspnea in respiratory diseases, particularly COPD. Walking should be assessed on level ground
purpose: A 5-point scale used to assess the degree of breathlessness in individuals with respiratory conditions. It ranges from 0 (not troubled by breathlessness except on strenuous exercise) to 4 (too breathless to leave the house or breathless when dressing or undressing).

code.display: modified Medical Research Council Dyspnea Scale (assessment scale)
Medical Research Council breathlessness scale grade

valueCoding.display: Grade 1: Not troubled by breathlessness except on strenuous exercise
Grade 2: Short of breath when hurrying on the level or walking up a slight hill
Grade 3: Walks slower than most people on the level, stops after a mile or so, or stops after 15 minutes walking at own pace
Grade 4: Stops for breath after walking about 100 yds or after a few minutes on level ground
Grade 5: Too breathless to leave the house, or breathless when undressing
